baseline_preferred: transfer without independently observed execution relationship
shell or deletion behavior without additional supported context
counterexamples: T1105 transfer without execution relationship abstains
relationship-only documents without explicit technique fields do not activate a rule

coverage_matrix.abstention: transfer alone, ambiguous parse, invalid evidence, conflict, or missing relationship
coverage_matrix.assumptions: execution relationship is a static observed feature, not proof that execution occurred
coverage_matrix.observed_behavior: download or transfer plus independently observed execution relationship
coverage_matrix.predicate: T1105 in grounded techniques AND download_execution_relationship is true
coverage_matrix.rationale: containment and instrumentation are appropriate for a transfer/execution relationship without changing real infrastructure

coverage_matrix.abstention: credential technique without command context, ambiguity, conflict, or invalid evidence
coverage_matrix.assumptions: credential-access-compatible behavior is not proof of malicious intent
context_required: credential indicators or credential path category
coverage_matrix.observed_behavior: credential-file or credential-tool access with credential context
coverage_matrix.predicate: grounded techniques intersect {T1003,T1552.001} AND credential context is present
coverage_matrix.rationale: only synthetic decoy credentials are exposed and instrumented

coverage_matrix.abstention: crontab text without persistence context, ambiguity, conflict, or invalid evidence
coverage_matrix.assumptions: the rule does not claim persistence succeeded on a real host
coverage_matrix.observed_behavior: cron persistence behavior with persistence indicator
coverage_matrix.predicate: T1053.003 in grounded techniques AND persistence_indicator is present
coverage_matrix.rationale: fictional operation continuity is limited to the contained simulator

coverage_matrix.abstention: network-related text without network context, ambiguity, conflict, or invalid evidence
coverage_matrix.assumptions: network discovery does not establish attacker intent
coverage_matrix.observed_behavior: network configuration discovery with network context
coverage_matrix.predicate: T1016 in grounded techniques AND network path category is present
coverage_matrix.rationale: only fictional host/service topology is revealed

coverage_matrix.abstention: discovery technique without observed discovery context, ambiguity, conflict, or invalid evidence
coverage_matrix.assumptions: discovery-compatible behavior is not treated as malicious intent
coverage_matrix.observed_behavior: system, file, directory, or service discovery
coverage_matrix.predicate: grounded techniques intersect {T1007,T1082,T1083} AND environment_discovery is present
coverage_matrix.rationale: the generator returns consistent fictional discovery results
required_evidence: T1007, T1082, or T1083 command-grounded evidence

coverage_matrix.abstention: any forbidden indicator, ambiguity, conflict, invalid evidence, or unsupported behavior
coverage_matrix.assumptions: classification and severity are contextual features, not independent truth labels
coverage_matrix.observed_behavior: explicitly benign administrative context without malicious behavior indicators
coverage_matrix.predicate: classification is benign AND severity is info AND forbidden indicator set is empty
coverage_matrix.rationale: low-interaction administrative response avoids unnecessary escalation
required_evidence: no credential, persistence, download, or execution indicator
sources: Don V2 evidence bundle contract; no single technique is sufficient

coverage_matrix.observed_behavior: valid evidence without a supported policy predicate
coverage_matrix.predicate: none of the non-baseline predicates match
coverage_matrix.rationale: preserve fail-safe behavior and avoid intent fabrication
required_evidence: valid gate but no complete rule match
